Add github.com/gorilla/websocket dependency to go.mod and run go mod tidy

Create web/dashboard/src/stores/appStore.ts with Zustand store: connected, agents Record, tasks Record, stats, isPaused, selectedAgentId, and actions for updateAgent, syncState, appendOutput

Create pkg/dashboard/handlers.go with REST API handlers: GET /api/state, GET/POST /api/agents, POST /api/agents/:id/kill, GET/POST/PATCH /api/tasks, POST /api/orch/pause and /resume, GET /api/stats
Create web/dashboard/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts hook that connects to ws://host/ws, handles reconnection with exponential backoff, dispatches events to Zustand store
